record.paper_title: On Plane Geometric Spanners: A Survey and Open Problems
record.original_question: Determine the best possible universal upper bound on the spanning ratio of a plane geometric graph on a finite planar point set.

evidence.quote: Open Problem 4. What is the best upper bound on the spanning ratio of a plane graph? The best that is currently known is an upper bound of 1.998.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a finite point set $P\subset\mathbb{R}^2$, a plane geometric graph on $P$ is a straight-line embedded graph with vertex set $P$ whose edges (drawn as Euclidean line segments) pairwise do not cross. For a connected geometric graph $G$ on $P$, define its spanning ratio (or stretch factor) by
$$\mathrm{sr}(G)=\max_{u,v\in P,\ u\neq v}\frac{d_G(u,v)}{\|u-v\|},$$
where $d_G(u,v)$ is the length of a shortest path from $u$ to $v$ in $G$ (using Euclidean edge lengths) and $\|u-v\|$ is the Euclidean distance.

Define
$$\rho^*=\inf\Bigl\{C\ge 1:\ \text{for every finite }P\subset\mathbb{R}^2\text{ there exists a connected plane geometric graph }G\text{ on }P\text{ with }\mathrm{sr}(G)\le C\Bigr\}.$$

Determine the exact value of $\rho^*$.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact best universal upper bound on the spanning ratio of plane geometric graphs remains open. The Delaunay triangulation gives the best known upper bound of 1.998 (Xia, 2013), while the best known lower bound is approximately 1.5932 (Xia–Zhang). Recent work (e.g., 2023–2025 papers on Delaunay variants) continues to address this long-standing open problem without closing the gap.

status_evidence.title: The Stretch Factor of the Delaunay Triangulation Is Less Than 1.998
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bound 1.998 by Xia, improving previous 2.42.

status_evidence.title: The Tight Spanning Ratio of the Rectangle Delaunay Triangulation
status_evidence.snippet: Tight bound for the standard Delaunay triangulation remains open; lower bound improved to 1.5932.
status_evidence.claim: The exact spanning ratio of the Delaunay triangulation, and hence the best plane spanning ratio, is still unknown.

status_evidence.title: Tight Routing and Spanning Ratios of Arbitrary Triangle Delaunay Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work on Delaunay-type plane spanners; the general problem remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Problem is still actively studied and open.
